newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT -Brazil Bombril still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Brazil Bombril still a buy.

text.p: Fator Securities said it was maintaining its speculative buy rating on Brazilian cleaning products maker Bombril.
- said the company is undervalued based on 1996 results.
- In April, Bombril said it was acquiring a controlling stake of up to 80 percent in Italian food company Cirio Spa for $380 million.

- said the company is going through a restructuring which is expected to be completed in July. Bombril will be a multinational comprising three units: Bombril, Italy's Cirio and Cirio Brazil, all already controlled by Cragnotti & Partners group, it said.
- said the company will be a consumer goods multinational with strong market shares, engaged primarily in the processed foods segments and, secondly, in hygiene and household cleaning.

- said the new structure has positive and negative sides. It found positive the creation of a multinational, with access to cheaper funds, and Cragnotti's leadership. But said the future of Cirio Brazil is still a concern.
- Bombril preferred was up 1.16 percent at 13.10 shortly before the market's close.
